Description of Fields: Triggers device to return its internal saved points list.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App sends this upon entering the Calibration screen.

Description of Fields: summary: Object containing each nutrient key with an array of calibrated points. file: Local file on device (informational; ignored by app).
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: The app checks summary and immediately marks matching points with green checkmarks in the overview matrix.

Description of Fields: nutrient / nutrients: Target nutrient (e.g. OC). point: Calibration level (blank, min, mid, max).
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App enters 'Calibrating...' screen. Sets loop counter to Loop 0/100. Resets channel values to placeholder (-).

Description of Fields: sample: 0-indexed loop (0 to total-1). total: Total loops required by device (e.g. 100 or 20). percent: Progress bar percentage (1 to 100).
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: Counter updates: Loop (sample + 1)/total (e.g. Loop 1/100). Progress bar fills smoothly.

Description of Fields: channels: Key-value map of floating-point readings for all 21 spectral channels (A..W
column9: Channel boxes light up with live numerical values (e.g. 751.01). Header updates: Live channel readings (21/21).

Description of Fields: Polled by app every 1.5 seconds during capture.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: Ensures connection is alive and monitors device operational state.

Description of Fields: Confirms capture thread is actively running on device.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App continues capture phase without timeouts.

Description of Fields: Device has finished all loops and written data to persistent storage.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: Halts capture mode. Saves point locally in app storage. Shows 'Calibration Successful' popup dialog. Adds green checkmark to the calibrated point card.

Description of Fields: Sent if user taps 'Cancel' or presses Android Back button.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App returns to idle calibration screen immediately.

Description of Fields: Device confirms capture thread was stopped and LEDs turned off.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App clears all active timers and remains on idle screen.

Description of Fields: Sent if I2C bus fails, sensor times out, or exception occurs.
Expected Mobile App UI Behavior: App displays error alert with the device message and offers a 'Retry' option.
